userScope: Use real Katana against the specified Scope to collect menus/functions and environment, paths, APIs, sensitive information, account differences, history changes and unconfirmed coverage while preserving eight tools and previous releases.

katana.distribution: External optional executable; no Katana binary is bundled in the JAR or source ZIP.
katana.mode: Pinned standard HTML/JavaScript/form/technology crawling; no Katana headless, automatic form fill, auto-login, knowledge-base provider validation or automatic update.
katana.transport: Authenticated ephemeral loopback HTTP proxy with HTTPS CONNECT terminated using a temporary in-memory certificate. Every target request uses the single existing Montoya worker, live Scope, selected HTTP identity, GET/HEAD restrictions and the same global request budget.
katana.privacy: Seed URL is supplied over stdin; selected account Cookie/Authorization are not placed in crawler arguments, environment or config. Child environment is minimized, JSON output is bounded and allowlisted, and raw originals remain in the existing evidence store.
katana.history: The declared Katana seed identity, comparison profiles, Scope, options, time/pages and credential revisions partition comparisons. Incomplete scans never prove remediation.
katana.upstreamCompatibility: Katana 1.8.0 omit-body mutates response bodies before JS parsing. The integration uses non-destructive output-field exclusion and keeps JavaScript discovery functional; actual native JS-only provenance is tested.
katana.vendorNote: Official Katana startup/version checking can clean its own resume files older than ten days under the caller home directory. HOME is preserved; application code does not modify these existing files directly. Own config/field/output workspaces are private and removed.

countingNote: One current Linux regression run; nested Mapper main is not double-counted. Separate real Katana checks and layout scenarios are not added to 4941. CI and earlier-version repetitions are not summed.

realKatana.scope: Real pinned Katana against isolated HTTP and HTTPS targets through the production proxy/Runner, real menus and JS-only endpoint, forms/technology metadata, account differences, masked history changes, pause/resume/stop, global budget and credential/log/workspace boundaries. No external targets or native Burp GUI.

captureScope: Production Swing components with synthetic packet, Katana and browser observations. Actual Katana transport has separate executable proof; guide images are not native Burp GUI screenshots.

preservation.mainBranch: not changed; task branch is stacked on the existing Simple 1.2.0 branch

toolchain.limitation: The local JDK lacks ct.sym; explicit source/target17 used. The configured GitHub workflow uses a full JDK17 and Node22 plus the real pinned Katana fixture. See PR/Actions for remote results.

practicalLimits: Katana is a separately installed trusted local executable. Scope mode does not use Katana headless; existing opt-in SPA browser helper remains separate.
GET/HEAD and known changing-path restrictions do not establish that every server implements side-effect-free GET behavior.
The body limit bounds decoded analysis/proxy reads, not Montoya download transport. Large dump/archive paths are excluded.
Menu/API/environment/DB/account findings retain confidence and source; they are not automatic vulnerability or deployed-product certificates.
Persistent history is masked metadata. Full packet evidence is kept in bounded current-session stores and can be explicitly exported.
notRun: Windows/macOS installation and native Katana runs
Manual Chrome/Edge helper installation or MV3/DNR integration for 1.3.0
